researchDepth: Bounded agency/attribution/reactance/moral-value/perspective landscape; all ten canonical records and eight incident propositions. Primary abstracts and selected methods/results; not a formal systematic review per Driver.

entityReviews.constructReview: Experience of initiating/controlling action and producing effects; not self-efficacy, legal responsibility or one implicit timing measure.
entityReviews.measurementReview: Binding, sensory attenuation and explicit agency can dissociate; no universal shorter-delay sign.
entityReviews.timeReview: Minutes; action/feedback timing and learned delay distribution matter.
entityReviews.unresolved: Canonical SRC197 PMID misresolves; intended DOI identified, no source repair. EA24 RN.

entityReviews.constructReview: Attribution of responsibility for producing/preventing outcome; distinguish causal involvement, intention, blame and punishment.
entityReviews.measurementReview: Judgments use causal/mental-state information differently; controllability is not locus alone.
entityReviews.timeReview: Minutes-hours; outcome knowledge and attribution order must be explicit.
entityReviews.unresolved: No exact direct effect retained from helping/punishment judgments alone.

entityReviews.constructReview: Nominal attribution locus: actor, situation, other or mixed; not a stable locus-of-control trait.
entityReviews.measurementReview: Unordered categories cannot be scalar INCREASE/DECREASE; optional weights need an explicit comparison.
entityReviews.timeReview: Situational attribution minutes-hours; not durable personality change.
entityReviews.unresolved: SRC163 BIS/BAS does not validate attribution locus. No scalar effect forced.

entityReviews.constructReview: Attribution of knowing/purposeful action; not the actor's actual intention or moral wrongness.
entityReviews.measurementReview: Desire, belief, foresight and control profile; side-effect judgment depends on culture/status, not universal harm rule.
entityReviews.timeReview: Judgment after vignette information, not evidence of actor's earlier causal state.
entityReviews.unresolved: Cross-cultural convenience comparisons not randomized culture effects; measure/profile scope unresolved.

entityReviews.constructReview: Perceived illegitimate restriction of behavioral/attitudinal freedom, not the objective restriction itself.
entityReviews.measurementReview: Four-item pressure/freedom-threat checks align more closely than surveillance scope or generic autonomy.
entityReviews.timeReview: Immediate health-message appraisal; not assumed lasting restrictions.
entityReviews.unresolved: Bounded high-control message EA23; social-value threat and bundled scripts constrain attribution.

entityReviews.constructReview: Current motivational arousal to restore threatened freedom; not trait reactance or all oppositional behavior.
entityReviews.measurementReview: Anger/negative-cognition composite can contain target counterarguments; REL-PSY-048 part-whole risk.
entityReviews.timeReview: Seconds-minutes/hours; measurement order not identified mediation.
entityReviews.unresolved: Retype-review only; no whole composite causes its own indicator.

entityReviews.constructReview: Attitude experienced as fundamental right/wrong; distinct from strength, correctness, religion and moral identity.
entityReviews.measurementReview: Moralization ratings, conviction, affect and behavior separate; longitudinal association not causal mediation.
entityReviews.timeReview: Days-weeks with possible situational onset; enduring moralization needs repeated measurement.
entityReviews.unresolved: CUL norms→individual conviction need level/timing/identification; existing F04/F05 reviews reused.

entityReviews.constructReview: Action-specific felt personal duty, not legal requirement, perceived approval or action frequency.
entityReviews.measurementReview: Norm-activation SEM and moral nudges' behavior outcomes do not directly establish felt obligation change.
entityReviews.timeReview: Minutes-hours/days; intention and performed action are distinct.
entityReviews.unresolved: Cross-sectional moral-obligation associations not causal pathways; direct action target uncertain.

entityReviews.constructReview: Relative transsituational priority hierarchy of personal values, not temporary value salience.
entityReviews.measurementReview: Ordinal ranks and relative importance require specified value/comparator; rank numeral sign can invert importance.
entityReviews.timeReview: Canonical weeks/months-years; four-week benevolence package evidence not permanent whole-hierarchy change.
entityReviews.unresolved: Generic canonical persistence text questionable, retained. Positive four-week results not rejected, but package/profile effect RN.

entityReviews.constructReview: Current capacity to represent another's knowledge/viewpoint/intentions; not affective empathy or compliance with instructions.
entityReviews.measurementReview: Visual-task selection, interpersonal accuracy and confidence are distinct operationalizations; task transfer unproven.
entityReviews.timeReview: Hours-days; acute sleep/task effects not enduring general capacity change.
entityReviews.unresolved: Perspective instruction EA25 RN; conversation adds information rather than proving capacity change.

existingReviews.rationale: Communal purity norms and individual moral conviction are different levels; realized exposure/internalization and target attitude must be specified.
existingReviews.nullContrary: Tight/loose culture and dehumanization sources do not test this exact norm→conviction contrast.
existingReviews.proposal: Specify norm, individual exposure, attitude, temporal order and identified design; no inferred mediator or revision implementation.
existingReviews.rdsReview: No RDS endpoints. Composite/indicator, ordinal-profile and individual/group aggregation risks retained.
existingReviews.executionReview: Existing active proposition, ownership and legacy incompleteness unchanged; no implemented revision, retype, numerical weight or pathway.

existingReviews.rationale: Shared sacred-tradeoff prohibition is not individual conviction; selection and mutual reinforcement may explain association.
existingReviews.nullContrary: No independent exogenous communal-prohibition manipulation aligned to this individual endpoint.
existingReviews.proposal: Restrict future proposal to exact prohibition/attitude/population and exposure sequence; replacement remains unimplemented.
existingReviews.rdsReview: No RDS endpoints. Composite/indicator, ordinal-profile and individual/group aggregation risks retained.
existingReviews.executionReview: Existing active proposition, ownership and legacy incompleteness unchanged; no implemented revision, retype, numerical weight or pathway.

existingReviews.rationale: Actual mandate scope, awareness and perceived legitimacy differ; algorithm/human monitoring identity is not scope.
existingReviews.nullContrary: Employee238 correlations and four algorithm-monitoring experiments do not identify institutional mandate scope→freedom threat.
existingReviews.proposal: Specify institution, surveillance dimension, perceived awareness/legitimacy and timing/design; no automatic monotonic personal threat.
existingReviews.rdsReview: No RDS endpoints. Composite/indicator, ordinal-profile and individual/group aggregation risks retained.
existingReviews.executionReview: Existing active proposition, ownership and legacy incompleteness unchanged; no implemented revision, retype, numerical weight or pathway.

existingReviews.rationale: Threatened important freedom can elicit reactance, bounded by message/population and legitimacy; experimentally assigned message is not independently randomized perceived threat.
existingReviews.nullContrary: Social-value threat alternative, bundled scripts and same-session measurements limit direct state→state identification.
existingReviews.rdsReview: No RDS endpoints. Composite/indicator, ordinal-profile and individual/group aggregation risks retained.
existingReviews.executionReview: Existing active proposition, ownership and legacy incompleteness unchanged; no implemented revision, retype, numerical weight or pathway.

existingReviews.rationale: Negative cognition contributes to measured reactance; treating the composite as an independent cause of its counterargument component risks circularity.
existingReviews.nullContrary: Dillard/Shen negative thoughts include disagreement, noncompliance and derogation, not exact counterargument quality alone.
existingReviews.proposal: Preserve future noncausal/measurement-overlap review; exact replacement predicate unresolved. Do not retype or deactivate.
existingReviews.rdsReview: No RDS endpoints. Composite/indicator, ordinal-profile and individual/group aggregation risks retained.
existingReviews.executionReview: Existing active proposition, ownership and legacy incompleteness unchanged; no implemented revision, retype, numerical weight or pathway.

existingReviews.rationale: Reactance is not universally positive for any specified behavior's group prevalence; opposition may reduce advocated behavior.
existingReviews.nullContrary: Person-level reactions, intentions and community denominators differ; COM-B/NATO not exact identified aggregate effect.
existingReviews.proposal: Specify actual behavior/direction, eligible population, opportunities and temporal aggregation; no generic contagion or sign.
existingReviews.rdsReview: No RDS endpoints. Composite/indicator, ordinal-profile and individual/group aggregation risks retained.
existingReviews.executionReview: Existing active proposition, ownership and legacy incompleteness unchanged; no implemented revision, retype, numerical weight or pathway.

hypotheses.question: High-control health messages increase perceived freedom threat.
hypotheses.reason: EA23 bounded scripts, populations and immediate four-item appraisal; no universal reactance/behavior effect.

hypotheses.question: Intentional binding is identical to perceived agency.
hypotheses.reason: Implicit/explicit measures dissociate; no semantic identity.

hypotheses.question: Shorter feedback delay universally increases agency.
hypotheses.reason: Learned delay distribution can reverse the explicit-rating pattern.

hypotheses.question: Coercion reduces explicit agency or responsibility.
hypotheses.reason: Implicit timing evidence does not independently establish exact explicit construct or legal responsibility.

hypotheses.question: Causal attribution locus increases on a scalar continuum.
hypotheses.reason: Nominal categories have no intrinsic order; a category shift needs a qualified specification.

hypotheses.question: Situational attribution locus equals stable locus of control.
hypotheses.reason: Attribution of one outcome differs from durable generalized expectation.

hypotheses.question: Intentionality, responsibility, blame and punishment are interchangeable.
hypotheses.reason: Causal and mental-state inputs contribute differently.

hypotheses.question: Bad side effects are universally judged intentional.
hypotheses.reason: Cross-cultural convenience cohorts include reversed side-effect patterns.

hypotheses.question: Specified controllability information changes responsibility attribution.
hypotheses.reason: Stigma/affect/helping results vary; exact responsibility endpoint and task need extraction.

hypotheses.question: Reactance independently causes its own negative-cognition indicator.
hypotheses.reason: Part-whole/shared-method dependence is not an independent causal contribution.

hypotheses.question: Reactance increases every behavior's prevalence.
hypotheses.reason: Opposition, advocacy behavior and aggregation denominator differ.

hypotheses.question: Actual cultural moral norms equal an individual's moral conviction.
hypotheses.reason: Group rule/exposure and personal moralization are separate.

hypotheses.question: Moral obligation equals perceived injunctive norm.
hypotheses.reason: Personal felt duty differs from perceived others' approval.

hypotheses.question: Norm activation→duty→behavior is an identified causal pathway.
hypotheses.reason: Cross-sectional SEM cannot identify transmitted effects or temporal order.

hypotheses.question: Four-week benevolence package changes relative personal-value priority.
hypotheses.reason: Three randomized studies support specified benevolence importance; bundle/component and full relative hierarchy need reconciliation.

hypotheses.question: Brief value salience changes every enduring value dimension.
hypotheses.reason: Momentary cue and relative durable priority are distinct.

hypotheses.question: Moral-rightness questions increase felt moral obligation.
hypotheses.reason: Economic-game/donation behavior is not a direct duty measure.

hypotheses.question: Perspective-taking instruction increases general perspective capacity.
hypotheses.reason: EA25 keeps accuracy nondetection/occasional decline; instruction does not equal skill.

hypotheses.question: Conversation increases perspective-taking capacity.
hypotheses.reason: Getting new information improves accuracy, not necessarily capacity.

hypotheses.question: Sleep loss reduces perspective-taking capacity.
hypotheses.reason: Specific level-one selection versus level-two interpretation; reuse sleep-loss identity, no broad capacity/BIO-F01 claim.

hypotheses.question: Trust in science modifies REL-PSY-047 or REL-PSY-048.
hypotheses.reason: Measured science-trust grouping not exact PSY-113 source credibility; no exact-edge moderator evidence.

hypotheses.question: Social-value threat independently produces reactance.
hypotheses.reason: Alternative predictive model, not independent causal mediator; exact canonical endpoint unresolved.

hypotheses.question: Moral conviction proves factual or moral correctness.
hypotheses.reason: Feeling fundamental right/wrong does not establish truth.

hypotheses.question: Algorithmic surveillance increases perceived freedom threat.
hypotheses.reason: Human-versus-algorithm monitoring and autonomy outcomes are not institutional scope or exact illegitimate-restriction appraisal.

hypotheses.question: Environmental crises change personal values.
hypotheses.reason: Life events, intervention and trauma designs heterogeneous; no uniform value/direction or immediate durable hierarchy.

hypotheses.question: Message→freedom threat→reactance→behavior has an identified transmitted effect.
hypotheses.reason: Threat check can follow cognition measurement; SEM and reachability do not establish causal mediation.

hypotheses.question: Perspective-taking instruction or task accuracy is capacity itself.
hypotheses.reason: Operation, information availability, confidence, selection and general ability differ.

hypotheses.question: Learned feedback timing modifies explicit agency ratings.
hypotheses.reason: EA24 preserves reversed delay pattern; scoped measure/learning history needed.

canonicalSourceReviews.finding: Stored PMID27765344 resolves Tay systemic-sclerosis review, not intended Moore2016 agency review DOI10.3389/fpsyg.2016.01272 PMID27621713. No repair; no affected finding used as exact empirical support.
Cushman2008 Crime and punishment DOI10.1016/j.cognition.2008.03.006 separates causal/intentional analyses and moral judgments; no equivalence of intention and blame.
BIS/BAS scale source not attribution locus or intentionality; source unchanged.

Intermingled message booklets; SEM samples196/200. High-control scripts also contain derogation/content differences; threat check follows cognition measures. Anger plus negative cognition not independently randomized mediators.
Skitka/Hanson/Morgan/Wisneski2021 review differs from same-title Skitka2010 SRC164; distinct DOI/year/authors. Overlap with included moralization studies not independent replication.
